required_release: Root explicit isolated benchmark release after fixed/fresh/native/final review pass and clean source commit; all other jobs and review I/O stopped.

output_resolution.source_basename: gen25-<actual committed HEAD first 7 hex characters>
output_resolution.commit_resolution: Resolve only after the reviewed source commit and clean-tree verification. No guessed commit or worker hash.
output_resolution.no_retry_or_relocation: Construct the correct path before the single isolated run; preserve any failure and all original data.

exact_signed_cpr_overhead: (CPR median nanoseconds - decode median nanoseconds) / 172432 / 1000 microseconds per message, separately for Lean and rs1090, without clamping or noise correction.
target_decision: For each mode Rust median >= 2 * Lean median; both must hold. No assumed outcome.
